name: Progressive Camera Placement for NeRF
aliases: Next Best View Estimation via Observation Frequency and Angular Uniformity
definition: A greedy optimization algorithm that selects camera positions to maximize a reconstruction quality metric E(C, B32), which combines observation frequency and angular uniformity, to improve NeRF reconstruction quality with fewer images.
summary: Progressive Camera Placement for NeRF is a greedy optimization algorithm that selects camera positions to maximize reconstruction quality by combining observation frequency and angular uniformity, avoiding the need for additional image acquisition.
